risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Embecta faces increased competition in the medical technology sector, which could affect its sales and operating results.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector, with firms having greater financial and marketing resources. This is mentioned multiple times in the report, particularly in the sections Risks Related to Embecta's Business and The medical technology industry is very competitive.

risks.title: Dependence on Key Products
risks.summary: Embecta is highly dependent on a few key products, making it vulnerable to any event that could impact the sales or profitability of these products.
risks.score_rationale: The company generates a significant portion of its profits and cash flows from a few key products, such as pen needles and syringes. This is mentioned in the section Risks Related to Embecta's Business.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruption Risks
risks.summary: Embecta is exposed to supply chain disruption risks due to its reliance on third-party suppliers for components and raw materials used in its products.
risks.score_rationale: The company sources components and raw materials from third parties, which may lead to supply chain disruption risks. This is mentioned in the section Risks Related to Embecta's Business.

risks.title: Technological Advancements
risks.summary: Technological advancements in diabetes treatment could render Embecta's products less competitive and affect its sales and operating results.
risks.score_rationale: Technological advancements in diabetes treatment could reduce demand for Embecta's products. This is mentioned in the section Risks Related to Embecta's Business.

risks.title: Risks Related to the Separation from BD
risks.summary: Embecta is exposed to risks related to the separation from BD, particularly regarding transition and the establishment of new structures.
risks.score_rationale: The company was recently separated from BD, which may lead to risks related to transition and setting up new structures. This is mentioned in the section Risks Related to the Separation and Distribution from BD.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.summary: Embecta is exposed to cybersecurity risks, which could negatively impact its operations and operating results.
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity breaches could have a negative impact on Embecta's business. This is mentioned in the section Risks Related to Embecta's Business.

risks.title: Debt-Related Risks
risks.summary: Embecta is exposed to debt-related risks, which could negatively impact its operations and operating results.
risks.score_rationale: The company has incurred debt that could negatively affect its business and operating results. This is mentioned in the section Risks Related to Embecta's Business.
